svg.title: The three Db2 12.1 AI editions
svg.desc: IBM offers Db2 12.1 in three AI editions. Db2 AI Community: free, up to 4 CPU cores and 16 GB of memory, with community support. Db2 AI Standard: up to 16 CPU cores and 128 GB of memory, for production, business-critical applications. Db2 AI Advanced: no resource limit, fully featured for mission-critical workloads. IBM's pricing page lists the license metric as VPC.
